name: bow_from_rest
description: From the rest pose into the play bow found with the pose editor (front legs squatted with the shoulders 75 and the knees -50, back legs extended with the shoulders 10 and the knees -45, the claw closed and the arm at its rest lift), held for a moment, then back to rest. Played from rest with `g2script bow_from_rest --from-rest --amount 1.0`.
